Define the degree-one BRST operator candidate $s$ on the fields by

$$sA_\mu=\partial_\mu c+[A_\mu,c],\qquad sc=-\frac12[c,c],\qquad s\psi=-\rho(c)\psi.$$

On coefficient functions set $sf=0$, and on every jet generator set $s(\Phi_I)=D_I(s\Phi)$; extend $s$ to $\mathcal F_U$ by the odd left-derivation rule $s(FG)=(sF)G+(-1)^{|F|}F(sG)$ for homogeneous $F$, where $|F|$ is total parity.
